name: pinpoint
description: Pin comments to elements on a localhost page and dispatch them, with screenshots, into a running Claude Code or Cowork session on your computer. Ask questions, park notes and watch fixes land.

token.title: Bridge token
token.description: Optional. A shared secret that the browser extension must send to the local bridge. Leave it empty unless other programs on this computer can reach localhost. Enter the same value on the extension's options page.
